title: SCA Minhag of the Week 187: "The First Song of Every Sebbit: Yahid Ram"

chapters.title: Introduction to Pizmonim
chapters.about: The book Shiru Bishbahal and the Hahamim who composed Pizmonim

chapters.title: Ya Hayid Ram
chapters.about: The King of Songs and its role as the opening for every Shabbat

chapters.title: Selecting Pizmonim by Occasion
chapters.about: Using Ya Hayid Ram as a segue to other songs like Yifat Ain and El Meod Na'ala

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the Minhag of singing Pizmonim on Shabbat, specifically focusing on the song Ya Hayid Ram. He explains that this song serves as the required opening for every Shabbat before transitioning into other Pizmonim based on the occasion.
questions: What is the first song we sing every Shabbat?
What is the purpose of the book Shiru Bishbahal?
How do we choose which Pizmonim to sing after the opening song?
What is the significance of the Ma'am Bayat scale in our Pizmonim?
